remarks: Stunning and Stylish | Mid-City Stamford  This beautifully renovated 1-bedroom, 11/2-bath condo delivers modern design and everyday comfort in one of Stamford's most convenient locations.  The open-concept layout is bright and spacious, with an updated kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, and plenty of room to cook and entertain. Both bathrooms are freshly renovated with clean finishes. A full-size in-unit laundry room rounds out the practical side nicely.  The living area is sun-filled and opens directly onto a private balcony. The primary bedroom is generously sized with a walk-in closet and its own balcony access via glass doors.  Two assigned parking spaces - one covered, one open - are included.  Minutes to Metro-North and steps from Stamford's dining, shopping, and entertainment scene. An easy commute and a great place to come home to.
